_help: Text for the briefing book (scripts/ui/briefing.gd). One entry per tab. 'body' lines are joined with newlines and support BBCode. The drawn diagram on the right page is in briefing.gd.

tabs.title: YOUR MISSION
body: [color=#ffd933]SURVIVE THE 10-MINUTE SHIFT[/color]
Keep the PUBLIC TRUST bar above zero until the timer reaches 10:00. If trust hits zero, the shift is over.
[color=#ffd933]HOW TRUST CHANGES[/color]
Sending the right team wins trust back. Letting an alert run out, or sending the wrong team, costs trust.
[color=#ffd933]ANSWER ALERTS EARLY[/color]
Every alert starts green, then turns yellow, then red. The sooner you send a team, the more trust you earn.

tabs.title: READ, THEN DISPATCH
body: [color=#ffd933]CHECK THE LIVE FEED[/color]
Right-click anywhere to open the feed, and again to close it. Reports often arrive before the alert does, so check it regularly.
[color=#ffd933]SEND A TEAM[/color]
- Click the alert, then click a team.
- Or press 1, 2, 3, then click the alert.
- Or drag a team card onto the alert.
[color=#ffd933]REUSE FINISHED TEAMS[/color]
A finished team waits on the map with a glowing tag. Click or drag it to the next alert.

tabs.title: PAUSE AND CONTROLS
body: [color=#ffd933]PAUSE ANY TIME[/color]
Press ESC to pause the shift. The timer and every alert stop until you resume.
[color=#ffd933]READ THIS AGAIN[/color]
In the pause menu, choose CONTROLS to open this briefing whenever you need a reminder.
[color=#ffd933]QUICK KEYS[/color]
- Right-click: open or close the live feed
- 1, 2, 3: pick a team
- Shift + click a sector: see its landmarks
- ESC: pause
